title: Residuals Are Not Enough: Limits of Physics-Informed Pre-Training for Scientific Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.19081v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific foundation models (SciFMs) aim to learn generalizable representations of physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), enabling transfer across tasks and domains. While physics-informed methods, which leverage PDE residuals as supervisory signals, have shown promise in scientific machine learning (SciML) for improving accuracy and reducing data requirements, their potential in the context of SciFMs remains relatively unexplored.   In this evaluation study, we investigate whether (and how) physics-informed pre-training improves the generalization, robustness, and data efficiency of SciFMs. We conduct systematic experiments across a diverse set of PDEs, ranging from simple problems with periodic boundary conditions to more challenging systems such as the Navier-Stokes equations and non-periodic geometries. translated_title: 残差还不够：物理信息预训练在科学基础模型中的局限性
translated_abstract: 科学基础模型旨在学习由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的物理系统的可泛化表示，从而实现跨任务和跨领域的迁移。尽管利用PDE残差作为监督信号的物理信息方法在科学机器学习（SciML）中已展现出提高精度和减少数据需求的前景，但其在科学基础模型背景下的潜力仍相对缺乏探索。在本评估研究中，我们探究了物理信息预训练是否（以及如何）提升科学基础模型的泛化能力、鲁棒性和数据效率。我们在多样化的PDE集合上开展了系统性实验，涵盖从具有周期性边界条件的简单问题到更具挑战性的系统，如Navier-Stokes方程和非周期几何结构。我们的结果表明，物理信息预训练在“良好”的简单问题设置中能带来明显收益，例如…
tldr: 系统评估表明，物理信息预训练仅在简单“良好”的PDE设置下对科学基础模型有明显收益，在Navier-Stokes等更复杂场景中存在明显局限。
en_tdlr: A systematic evaluation showing that physics-informed pre-training benefits scientific foundation models only in simple "nice" PDE settings, revealing clear limits under challenging problems like Navier-Stokes.
